title: Which FNAF character are you? Free Five Nights at Freddy's quiz — cv.cm
description: Free FNAF quiz: answer 12 questions to find out if you're Freddy, Bonnie, Chica, Foxy, Golden Freddy, Mangle, Springtrap or the Puppet. Unofficial Five Nights at Freddy's fan quiz, no sign-up.
lede: Leader of the band like Freddy, a daredevil like Foxy or the quiet guardian like the Puppet? Answer 12 questions to find your Five Nights at Freddy's match.
about: Five Nights at Freddy's, the horror game Scott Cawthon released in 2014, turned a children's pizzeria full of animatronic mascots into one of the best-known game series of its time, with many sequels, books and a film. Its characters each have a clear personality: Freddy Fazbear, the band's frontman; Bonnie, the cool guitarist; Chica, who loves pizza; Foxy, the pirate who bursts out of Pirate Cove; mysterious Golden Freddy; Mangle, the tangled, rebuilt attraction; Springtrap, who keeps coming back; and the Puppet, the watchful figure in the music box. This quiz matches you with one of these eight.

Your result names your character and shows your scores for all eight. The questions are about personality, not jumpscares or lore. This is an unofficial fan quiz written for cv.cm. It is not affiliated with or endorsed by Scott Cawthon or Steel Wool Studios; the names belong to their owners.

faq.a: Freddy, Bonnie, Chica, Foxy, Golden Freddy, Mangle, Springtrap and the Puppet.

faq.q: Is one result rarer than the others?
faq.a: Every character appears in the same number of answers, so each one is equally likely.

faq.q: Does the quiz have spoilers or scares?
faq.a: No. It's about personality only, with no story twists and no jumpscares.

freddy.name: Freddy Fazbear
freddy.body: You're the frontman: confident, steady and the one everyone looks to. You like things done properly, you keep the group together and you're happiest when the show goes to plan. Just remember the band sounds best when everyone gets a turn in the spotlight.

bonnie.name: Bonnie
bonnie.body: You're cool, creative and laid-back. You let your talent do the talking, you rarely lose your temper and music, or whatever your art is, matters a lot to you. Friends love how calm you stay when things get loud.

chica.name: Chica
chica.body: You're cheerful, caring and always thinking about food. You're the host who makes sure everyone's fed and happy, and your good mood is contagious. You get distracted sometimes, but nobody minds when you show up with pizza.

foxy.name: Foxy
foxy.body: You're bold, fast and a bit of a rebel. You like doing things your own way, you make a dramatic entrance and you'd rather chase an adventure than wait around. Your energy is exciting; just look before you leap now and then.

goldenfreddy.name: Golden Freddy
goldenfreddy.body: You're mysterious, rare and hard to read. You turn up when people least expect it, you keep your thoughts to yourself and that air of mystery makes people curious about you. Let someone in once in a while; they'll be glad you did.

mangle.name: Mangle
mangle.body: You're creative, chaotic and often misunderstood. You've been pulled in different directions and put yourself back together, and you're tougher for it. Your mind works in unusual ways, which makes you great at surprising solutions.

springtrap.name: Springtrap
springtrap.body: You're persistent, patient and impossible to keep down. Setbacks don't stop you; you just come back, again and again. That staying power is rare. Make sure you're chasing things that are worth it, and let people see your softer side.

puppet.name: The Puppet
puppet.body: You're watchful, protective and quietly caring. You keep an eye on the people who need it most, often without them knowing, and you don't need credit. You like calm and routine; your music box is whatever helps you stay settled.
